PROMPT: Show cpi, financial plan percentage with levels subfund, year, agency limited to Fund Type = 'Special Revenue Funds - Other', Year = '2016'
QUERY_TEXT:

  fund.subfund AS subfund
  ,year.year AS year
  ,function.agency AS agency
  ,fin_plan_shr_parent

  ,cpi
FROM ANALYTIC VIEW (

    HIERARCHIES (
       fund
       ,year
       ,function)
  )

  fund.level_name = 'SUBFUND'
  AND year.level_name = 'YEAR'
  AND function.level_name = 'AGENCY'
  AND fund_type = 'Special Revenue Funds - Other'
  AND year = '2016'
ORDER BY 
  fund.subfund
  ,year.year
  ,function.agency

  financial_plan.financial_plan_category AS financial_plan_category
  ,fund.fund AS fund
  ,function.agency AS agency
  ,year.year AS year
  ,dollars_chg_ya

  ,function_shr_parent
FROM ANALYTIC VIEW (
  USING nys_spending_av
    HIERARCHIES (
       financial_plan
       ,fund
       ,function
       ,year)
  )
WHERE
  financial_plan.level_name = 'FINANCIAL_PLAN_CATEGORY'
  AND fund.level_name = 'FUND'
  AND function.level_name = 'AGENCY'
  AND year.level_name = 'YEAR'
  AND fund_type = 'Capital Projects Funds - Other'
  AND agency = 'Miscellaneous'
  AND year = '2019'
ORDER BY 
  financial_plan.financial_plan_category
  ,fund.fund
  ,function.agency
  ,year.year
